description: Search the CAC public generative AI, deep-synthesis and algorithm lists by a Chinese or English substring in the listed service or algorithm name, filer legal name, curated filer English name, or CAC filing number. Registry defaults to all; province applies to generative AI rows with a CAC province field. A us_list=true filter uses confirmed tier A legal-entity crosswalks only; brand uses an exact filer legal-name allowlist. Returns the CAC number, name and filer as printed, a separately labelled own English name or MORVS translation when available, CAC notice, date and its date type. The CAC says completed filing (备案) or registered (登记); neither grants approval. Filings are neither distinct models nor distinct companies. A brand in a filer legal name does not establish ownership. No match does not establish that a service or company is absent from China.

brand.description: If true, return only brand-name matches; a brand in a legal name does not prove ownership.

province.description: Optional province as published in the CAC register.

q.description: Chinese or English service, algorithm, filer or filing-number substring, at most 80 characters.

registry.description: CAC registry: genai_filed, genai_registered, deep_synthesis or algorithm; defaults to all.

us_list.description: If true, return only tier A crosswalk matches to a US list.

name: china_ai_filings
title: Find China AI Filings
